Nap Timer

A power-nap countdown with 10/20/26/90-minute presets, custom length and a gentle wake-up chime.

0:00:00

Choose a length, then start your nap. 😴

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a preset or enter a custom number of minutes.
  2. Press Start nap and rest — the countdown runs live.
  3. A gentle chime plays when your nap ends.
  4. Press Stop to cancel early.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which nap length should I choose?

A 10–20 minute power nap boosts alertness without grogginess; 90 minutes completes a full sleep cycle. The 26-minute preset comes from NASA's famous cockpit-nap study.

Can I set a custom nap length?

Yes — set any custom length from 1 to 480 minutes.

How will I be woken up?

A soft three-note chime plays when time is up. Keep this tab open and your volume on so you hear it.
